# Part VIII. Negotiation {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note .part-overview icon=false}
## Why this part comes here

Negotiation combines decision analysis, strategic interdependence, persuasion, emotion, and communication. Claiming and creating value are not separate worlds: preparation protects the ability to walk away, while curiosity reveals whether the apparent pie is too small.
:::

## Guiding questions

- What will I do without agreement?
- Where is the bargaining zone, and how uncertain is that estimate?
- Which differences in priorities, beliefs, risk, or time can create value?
- What agreement structure will survive implementation?
